description: This file contains utility functions for text normalization, comparison, and alignment, specifically for processing spoken language transcripts, including functions to compare texts, normalize text, strip HTML tags, and handle word alignment and comparison results.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Converts input text to lowercase, removes punctuation, trims whitespace, splits into words, and filters out empty strings.

methods.name: compareTexts
methods.description: Compares two texts and returns a comparison result indicating correctness, partial correctness, or incorrectness, along with detailed word alignment.

methods.name: toMissing
methods.description: Creates a ComparisonWord indicating a missing expected word.

methods.name: toExtra
methods.description: Creates a ComparisonWord indicating an extra actual word.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for a needle in a haystack and returns comparisons and updated haystack.

methods.name: matchTexts
methods.description: Aligns and compares original and utterance words, identifying matches, omissions, and insertions.

methods.name: alignWords
methods.description: Aligns words from original and utterance texts to facilitate comparison.

methods.name: stripHtmlTags
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string.
